indicators.flag: Provide inaccurate or incomplete customer identification or KYC information when attempting to open an account
indicators.red_flag: Inaccurate or incomplete customer identification / KYC information provided at account opening
indicators.rationale: Onboarding KYC completeness/accuracy validation is a standard control at a mid-size US bank or VASP, run against core account-opening data.

indicators.flag: Attempt to access a virtual currency exchange from an IP address or VPN connected to a sanctioned jurisdiction
indicators.red_flag: Virtual currency exchange access from an IP address or VPN tied to a sanctioned jurisdiction
indicators.rationale: Detecting access from a sanctioned-jurisdiction IP/VPN needs external IP-geolocation and VPN-attribution feeds the institution does not natively hold, so the data must be sourced before a signal is buildable.

indicators.flag: Are non-responsive or refuse to provide updated customer identification or KYC information
indicators.red_flag: Non-responsive to or refuses requests for updated customer identification / KYC information
indicators.rationale: Periodic KYC refresh exists at most mid-size institutions and the response status sits in core account/KYC data, but systematically flagging non-response is only partially instrumented.

indicators.flag: Are non-responsive or refuse to provide additional transaction information in response to a virtual currency company’s request
indicators.red_flag: Non-responsive to or refuses a virtual currency company's request for additional transaction information
indicators.rationale: Request-for-information non-response is a concrete account-level pattern derivable from core RFI/case data, but it is rarely turned into a standing signal — a buildable gap on data already held.

build_logic.logic: Flag an account with one or more open transaction-information requests (RFIs) past the response deadline and a response rate below threshold, weighted up when post-request outbound value continues, indicating evasive non-cooperation.
build_logic.source: RFI/case-management records joined to account and transaction ledger
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert → sanctions/AML analyst review gate

indicators.flag: Attempt to transact with a virtual currency address associated with a blocked person or sanctioned jurisdiction
indicators.red_flag: Attempted transaction with a virtual currency address linked to a blocked person or sanctioned jurisdiction
indicators.rationale: Matching a counterparty virtual-currency address to a blocked person or sanctioned jurisdiction requires blockchain chain-analytics exposure data that is only partially deployed, so existing screening can be enhanced but not fully closed from core data.
